verdict.rationale: Composio documents and exposes an official hosted MCP server (session `mcp: true`, and the shared 'Composio Connect' MCP URL) that any MCP-compatible agent/client can point at, and a live runtime probe confirms the endpoint (connect.composio.dev/mcp) is real and gated by managed OAuth as documented. This is a fair and clearly-applicable capability for an integration platform, backed by first-party docs plus independent endpoint verification. Missing for 10: an independent third-party report of a successful end-to-end agent session over this MCP endpoint (only auth-challenge probe, not a full tool-call transcript).
